summary: Per second on three meters: vCPU on the machine's size while running, memory on what is actually resident, disk on bytes written in every state.

egress.note: Not published; do not assume it is free.

notes: Memory is billed on resident memory; the calculator uses the memory you entered as the resident figure, up to the size's full allocation.
$30 of credit needs a card; without one an account is capped at two machines.
Egress and snapshot storage prices are not published, so neither is included.

upkeep.label: What you keep up
upkeep.detail: boxd runs the kernel and the isolation, but machines are kept, and forks and machines made from snapshots keep their source image. Who updates the packages inside a machine is not published, so assume you do.

source.quote: Forks and machines created from a snapshot keep their source machine's image, so create a fresh machine from the default image to get it.
